items.title: 6.5 Enthalpy change of reaction and chemical bonds (reaction ki enthalpy change aur bonds) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.5, printed page 123, with Sample Problem 6.1.

blocks.title: Chemical reaction
blocks.text: Chemical reaction woh process hai jis mein purane bonds tootte hain aur naye bonds bante hain.
Is liye reaction ki enthalpy change (ΔHr) asal mein bonds ke tootne aur banne se hi aati hai.

Chemical bond energy ki ek shakal hai jise chemical energy kehte hain (jo doosri energies ki tarah har type ki energy mein badal sakti hai). Bond torne mein energy absorb hoti hai (ΔH = +ve) aur bond banne mein energy nikalti hai (ΔH = –ve); in dono ka farq ΔH ka sign tay karta hai. Yani reaction exothermic hai ya endothermic, yeh net (kul) change se pata chalta hai.
Agar naye bonds banne mein nikalne wali energy bonds torne mein lagne wali energy se zyada ho to reaction exothermic hota hai. Ulta ho to reaction endothermic hota hai.

Misal: pani banne mein H–H bonds (hydrogen molecules ke) aur O=O bonds (oxygen molecules ke) torne ke liye energy chahiye, aur H–O bonds (pani ke) banne mein energy nikalti hai. H–O bonds banne mein nikalne wali energy H–H aur O=O torne wali energy se zyada hai, is liye net reaction exothermic hai. Is tarah:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan '(Figure 6.5)' ka hawala deti hai, lekin Figure 6.5 hydration ki figure hai; pani ke bonds ki koi figure yahan nahi chhapi.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 6.1
blocks.problem:
Neeche di gai bond energies se is reaction ki enthalpy change nikalein:
EH–H = 436 kJ mol⁻¹ ; EO=O = 495 kJ mol⁻¹ aur EH–O = 463 kJ mol⁻¹
H₂(g) + ½ O₂(g) → H₂O(g)
steps: Tootne wale bonds: ek H–H aur aadha O=O. Bante hain: pani ke do H–O bonds (H–O–H).
Bond torne ki energy (∑ER) = 436 + ½(495) = 436 + 247.5 = 683.5 kJ
blocks.answer: ΔH°r = –242.5 kJ mol⁻¹ (manfi, yani reaction exothermic hai)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki line '[EH–H + EO=O]' mein O=O ke saath ½ chhoot gaya hai; sahi [EH–H + ½EO=O] – [2 EH–O] hai. Agli line mein kitab khud ½ × 495 = 247.5 leti hai, is liye jawab –242.5 kJ mol⁻¹ sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O(g) mein tootne aur banne wale bonds ginein aur Table 6.1 se ΔH ka andaza lagayein (C–H 413, O=O 498, C=O 728, O–H 463).
blocks.explanation: Toote: 4 C–H (4 × 413 = 1652) aur 2 O=O (2 × 498 = 996), total 2648 kJ absorb. Bane: 2 C=O (2 × 728 = 1456) aur 4 O–H (4 × 463 = 1852), total 3308 kJ nikli. ΔH = 2648 – 3308 = –660 kJ mol⁻¹, exothermic. (Average values sirf andaza deti hain; asal napi hui value is se alag alag hai.)

items: ΔHr = ∑ER (bonds torne mein absorb) – ∑EP (bonds banne mein release).
Banne wali energy zyada ho to exothermic: pani ke liye 683.5 – 926 = –242.5 kJ mol⁻¹.
